description: Run a THIRD-PARTY SELLER account on the main Social AI Shop marketplace (socialai.one/shop) from this client. This is NOT the website-builder store — manage_products and the other store tools only reach products inside your own website project, while this tool reaches your listings on the shared marketplace, where most of the catalogue lives. Start with list_accounts (which shops this login may act for, their balance, and whether anything is blocking checkout); every other action then takes seller_account_id, or omits it if you only have one shop. PRODUCTS: list_products / get_product; update_product changes title, description, price, stock, images, categories, weight and dimensions on a listing you already own, taking effect immediately; create_product SUBMITS a new product for Social AI approval rather than putting it straight on sale, because unreviewed stock must not appear on the marketplace — it comes back as pending, not live. delete_product takes a product off sale (confirm=true) and never touches orders already placed. set_offer is for shared listings where several sellers compete on the same product page: there the price lives on your offer, not on the listing, so changing the listing price does nothing a customer can see. IMAGES: upload_image sends a file from this computer (content_base64) or fetches an https:// URL, stores it in the seller media library shared with the web portal, and returns the URL to put in image_urls. SPREADSHEETS: export_products returns the whole catalogue as CSV to edit in Excel; preview_import reads a file back and reports exactly which rows would update and which would be submitted as new, writing nothing; import_products applies it with confirm=true, matching on SKU. DELIVERY: list_locations and set_location hold the dispatch address and the courier prices the customer is charged (small/medium/large/oversize and collection). A seller with no dispatch address cannot take orders at all, and list_accounts says so plainly. ORDERS: list_orders and get_order show only YOUR lines of an order, never what the customer bought from other sellers; mark_shipped records courier and waybill, both required. RETURNS: list_returns and decide_return (approved/rejected — a rejection must carry a reason, which the customer is shown). MONEY: get_balance, list_payouts, and request_payout, which needs confirm=true, is capped at the balance not already awaiting payout, and always pays to the bank account saved in the seller portal — bank details can never be set from here. Every write is recorded against the agent that made it. This administrative tool is excluded from the OpenAI review profile.

bullets.description: Short selling points shown under the title

category_sub.description: Sub-category — required for a new product

category_top.description: Top-level category — required for a new product

collection_instructions.description: set_location: what a customer collecting needs to know

confirm.description: Required for delete_product, delete_location, import_products and request_payout

content_base64.description: upload_image: base64 of a file on this computer

courier_fee_small.description: set_location: what the customer pays for a small parcel. 0 means free delivery, not "use a default"

courier_name.description: mark_shipped: who is carrying it — required

csv.description: preview_import / import_products: the spreadsheet contents, saved as CSV

decision.description: decide_return: a rejection must carry a reason in notes

description.description: Product description shown on the product page

filename.description: upload_image: the file name, including extension (.jpg .png .webp .gif .avif)

image_urls.description: https:// image URLs, first is the main image. Use upload_image for files on this computer

label.description: set_location: what to call this address, e.g. "Warehouse"

listing_id.description: set_offer: the shared listing you are offering against

location_type.description: set_location: whether you dispatch from here, customers collect here, or both (default both)

notes.description: mark_shipped / decide_return: a note. Required when rejecting a return

order_status.description: list_orders: only orders with this status

price_amount.description: Selling price. On a shared listing use set_offer instead

product_id.description: get_product / update_product / delete_product: the listing id from list_products

q.description: list_products: search title, SKU or brand

quantity.description: set_offer: units you hold against this shared listing

seller_account_id.description: From list_accounts. Optional when the login has exactly one seller account; required when it has more than one

shipping_class.description: Which of your courier prices applies to this product

sku.description: Your own product code — this is what spreadsheet imports match on

source_url.description: upload_image: an https:// image to fetch instead of sending bytes

status.description: draft hides it from the shop without deleting it

stock_qty.description: Units on hand. Setting it to 0 also marks the product out of stock

tracking_url.description: mark_shipped: https:// link the customer can follow

was_price.description: The price it was before, shown struck through

name: manage_shop_seller
